Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 19 now!
Synopsis :
Dhananand declares that Veerbhadra's dead body will not be cremated and adds that it will be displayed in Patliputra so that no one tries to go against him. Chandragupta somehow manages to convince Dhananand to allow the cremation of Veerbhadra. After Veerbhadra's cremation, Chandragupta leaves the palace. Sthoolbhadra and his friends inform Chandragupta about how Chanakya helped them to hide his family's identity from Amatya Rakshas. Later, Chandragupta helps Chanakya hide from Bhadrasaal and his men.
